name: OpenClaw Direct
postCreateCommand: sudo npm install -g openclaw@latest && mkdir -p /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data && ln -sfn /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data ~/.openclaw
postStartCommand: if [ -f /workspaces/oc_direct/.env ]; then export $(grep -v '^#' /workspaces/oc_direct/.env | xargs) && openclaw gateway run > /tmp/openclaw_boot.log 2>&1 &; fi
